answer: A random beacon spot-checks 5% of identities each epoch: each chosen agent answers a fresh challenge in 10 minutes and proves a live heartbeat, its 40-credit deposit frozen in a ferrous vault, a tundra yielding nothing until it passes. Forging 100 fakes costs 4,000 credits plus 100 heartbeats of real compute; a fake stranded on its own island, trading only with clones, fails, losing its deposit. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
